outcome: Optimal location for additional service centers
cohort: Pregnant women in three districts of Gujarat, India
finding: Using Geographic Information System technology, the study found that 50-84% of the population in three districts of Gujarat, India had access to free C-section facilities within 20km, and by adding 4-6 centers in underserved regions, coverage could increase to 80-96%.
mod_finding: The study specifically focuses on improving access to C-section, a mode of delivery, and identifies optimal locations for additional service centers to improve access.
